prepare: argon collections prepare orders -p docs-review -b main
sandbox: argon sandbox create -p docs-review --from main --name agent-review --ttl 1h
restoreBranch: argon restore branch -p docs-review -b main --lsn "$BASELINE_LSN" --as recovered
baseline: export BASELINE_LSN="$(argon time-travel info -p docs-review -b main --output json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["latest_lsn"])')"
